description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' which implements common functionality for HTTP message objects, including managing headers, protocol version, and body stream, used by request and response classes in the PSR-7 standard.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a given header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves the header values concatenated as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified header added.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified body stream.
